title: Baler: The Last Soldiers of a Finished War
summary: Recounts how a Spanish detachment of some fifty men barricaded themselves inside the church of Baler in the Philippines on the first of July, eighteen ninety-eight, and held out for three hundred and thirty-seven days without accepting that Spain had lost the war and surrendered the islands. The episode ranges from beriberi, desertion and the officers who died inside the church to the newspapers the defenders dismissed as forgeries, and to Aguinaldo's decree that sent them home not as prisoners but as sons
